statement: The inspected xone receiver and GIP gamepad code creates per-client Linux gamepad input, battery and LED classes, with receiver-level pairing and shared LED controls; a separately identified headset class can provide ALSA playback and capture. The inspected receiver, gamepad and headset paths do not register keyboard or pointer companion devices. This negative result is restricted to those paths.
